features.name: Band: Flat 3.2 × 2.4, its shoulders swelling to the head
Basket: four claws tied by two rails
Seat bur, through to the finger, cut at the bench
Drop window, through both side faces along the finger
Array the window down the shoulder
Mirror the first window to the other shoulder
Mirror the array to the other shoulder

field_notes: Lost wax: no undercut anywhere — this pattern would also pull from two-part sand.
Measured with the ring as built: 6 CAD parts (1 joined, 5 cut), 289.6 mm² of part surface; under lost wax they are reported, never gating.
Lost wax: Basket "Basket: four claws tied by two rails" (#3) would undercut a two-part pull over 55.9 mm² (worst -81°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.

Lost wax: Seat bur "Seat bur, through to the finger, cut at the bench" (#4) would undercut a two-part pull over 20.5 mm² (worst -89°) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.

thickness.note: Up to 384 surface-normal samples on the display mesh; small unsampled features and oblique walls require section inspection

thickness_finished_informational.note: The finished ring after the bench's seat bur, which notches the claws for the girdle and opens the pilot; not the pour.
